name: Winter Coat
description: A padded winter coat, seams split at one shoulder. It is a warm room you can walk around in.

name: Snow Parka
description: A hooded parka with a fur-trimmed hood. Made for a mountain and wasted on a street.

name: Thermal Undershirt
description: A thin thermal top that does more than it looks like it should.

name: Thermal Leggings
description: Thermal leggings, worn under whatever else there is.

name: Insulated Trousers
description: Quilted work trousers off a cold-store peg. Stiff, heavy, and warm to the knee.

name: Wool Hat
description: A knitted wool hat, pulled out of shape. Most of the heat leaves through a bare head.

name: Wool Scarf
description: A long wool scarf. Round the face it keeps the wind out of your collar.

name: Wool Gloves
description: Thick wool gloves. Warm hands, clumsy fingers.

name: Insulated Boots
description: Felt-lined boots with a heavy sole. Cold ground stays where it is.

name: Wool Blanket
description: A grey wool blanket, worn thin in the middle. Round the shoulders it is a coat.

name: Down Vest
description: A puffy down vest, taped where it split. Warm over the chest and nowhere else.

name: Rain Poncho
description: A folded plastic poncho from a gift-shop rack. It flaps, it rustles, and it keeps the rain off.

name: Hooded Raincoat
description: A proper waxed raincoat with a deep hood. Dry, and warm enough to argue about.

name: Tarp Poncho
description: A builder's tarp with a slit cut for a head. Ugly, loud, and the water runs off it.

name: Sun Hat
description: A wide straw hat. It throws a little shade of its own.

name: Cotton Bandana
description: A faded cotton bandana. Wet, tied at the neck, it is worth more than it looks.

name: Linen Shirt
description: A loose linen shirt gone soft with washing. It breathes and it stops nothing.

name: Cotton Shorts
description: Cut-off shorts, frayed at the hem. Cool, and no protection at all.

name: Canvas Sandals
description: Canvas sandals with a rope sole. Quiet, cool, and one nail away from useless.

name: Mesh Vest
description: A high-visibility mesh vest off a road crew. It is holes held together by tape.

name: Roll-Top Dry Bag
description: A rubberised bag that rolls shut at the top. Whatever goes in stays dry.

name: Gun Case
description: A padded hard case with a broken latch. Long things ride in it and nothing rattles.

name: Drop-Leg Pouch
description: A pouch strapped down the thigh. It swings when you run and it is always where your hand is.

name: Dump Pouch
description: A collapsing canvas bag on a belt clip. Things go in fast and sort themselves out later.

name: Sling Bag
description: A single-strap bag that swings round to the front. Small, quick, and not enough.
